import json, pathlib, subprocess, sys, time
folder=pathlib.Path('/work/home/resolved68-assessment'); folder.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
base=[sys.executable,'scientific/resolved-v68/assess.py']
ids=['anchor-r64-z64-g128-t256','radial-r32-z64-g128-t256','axial-r64-z32-g128-t256','liner-r64-z64-g64-t256']
commands=[('audit-'+value,base+['case','/work/home/resolved68-campaign',str(folder/('audit-'+value)),value]) for value in ids]
commands += [(axis,base+[axis,'/work/home/resolved68-campaign',str(folder/axis)]) for axis in ('radial','axial','liner')]
records=[]
for label,command in commands:
 started=time.monotonic()
 result=subprocess.run(command,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=240)
 (folder/(label+'.log')).write_text(result.stdout+'\n'+result.stderr)
 records.append({'label':label,'command':command,'exitCode':result.returncode,'seconds':time.monotonic()-started})
 (folder/'receipts.json').write_text(json.dumps(records,indent=2)+'\n')
 print(label,result.returncode,result.stdout[-2000:],result.stderr[-1000:],flush=True)
sys.exit(0 if all(row['exitCode']==0 for row in records) else 1)
